summary: OpenAI announced new Codex product features—role-specific plugins bundling third-party apps and skills, a preview of shareable interactive Sites, and inline annotations—aimed at extending Codex use beyond software developers to roles like analysts, marketers, sales and bankers.

mechanisms.reason: A stated large and growing weekly user base implies rising aggregate usage/token volume on Codex.
mechanisms.quote: More than 5 million people now use Codex every week.

practices.reason: A new plugin ecosystem and directory changes how teams would connect Codex to third-party tools and manage permissions.
practices.quote: Role-specific plugins are rolling out in Codex in supported regions. You can install them from the Codex plugin directory and Codex will help get you set up.
